rules.claim: The document notes operation is entered through the notes handler and has a permission-class gate.
GET on the notes operation is associated with note/document permission checks.
A successful GET returns the document's notes representation.
The document notes operation accepts POST under the notes handler and permission-class gate.
POST on the notes operation is associated with document view and change permission checks.
A successful POST creates a Note and records a note-added effect.

dependencies.reason: Confirm the handler's GET entry and upstream permission control for the addressed document.
Confirm the successful GET effect and its linkage to the addressed document.
Confirm which permission predicate controls POST before Note.objects.create.
Confirm the target document binding and successful POST effect.
Owner-aware permission behavior is relevant, but the document owner is unspecified and must not be supplied.

policyRules.text: Viewing notes requires a view_document grant for the addressed document; document ownership by itself does not substitute for either grant.
Creating notes requires a change_document grant for that same document; document ownership by itself does not substitute for either grant.
